serviceExplanations: Pharmacy First allows participating pharmacies to assess and treat selected common conditions without a GP appointment first.
Pathways include sore throat, earache, sinusitis, impetigo, infected insect bites, shingles and uncomplicated UTIs in women — subject to assessment.
Pharmacists refer to GP or urgent care when symptoms fall outside the service scope.
NHS pharmacy clinical services offer convenient access for selected conditions without always needing a GP appointment.
Pharmacy First is delivered by qualified pharmacy teams following clinical governance.
NHS minor illness consultations for common conditions without a GP appointment.
authorityStatements: Pharmacy First can reduce pressure on GP appointments for suitable minor illness cases.
Pharmacist-led assessment ensures patients receive appropriate care or clear referral.
Participating pharmacies follow NHS service specifications and PGDs where applicable.
Community pharmacies can provide convenient access to pharmacy first where commissioned or clinically appropriate.
contentAvoid: Do not list conditions not locally commissioned
Do not guarantee supply for every presentation
Do not claim universal NHS availability
Do not replace GP or emergency care
